nota: A área é registro (camada 21, relida hoje; quadro de Hamlin: 17.924 acres). As duas distâncias são medição do canal (Plaza do NRHP/LMS até a costa aberta e até o ponto GNIS de Wilmington), não do registro do condado que o crédito da cena cita.
narracao: Los Angeles became a city in April 1850, about twenty-eight square miles around the old Plaza. From the Plaza, the nearest open beach is about fourteen miles away. Wilmington, where the harbor is today, is about nineteen. And the coast it faced had no harbor. In 1886, Colonel Mendell of the Army Corps of Engineers wrote that the only deep-water harbors in California were San Francisco and San Diego. San Pedro Bay, in between, was an open anchorage, exposed to the southeast and south, where the winter storms came from.
